section.sectionSummaryBrief: Shemini Atzeret is the essence of all matters of Tishrei, where they are absorbed and then drawn forth for the entire year, enabling the Jewish people to transform their worldly affairs into a dwelling place for Hashem.
section.t: Now, on Shemini Atzeret
(Shemini from the word "fat" [sheimen]79)
it is the extract and essence80
of all the matters of the month of Tishrei81,
and in it are absorbed
(Atzeret from the word for absorption [klitah]5)
all of these matters.
And through this are drawn
(all the matters of the month of Tishrei)
upon the entire year,
as the Tzemach Tzedek82 said,
"In it
(on Shemini Atzeret)
all of Israel receive the flow of their conduct in their Torah and their service for the entire year."
And this is "On the eighth day he sent
(the king)
the people etc. and they went to their tents,"
for from the aspect of Malchus that was drawn on Rosh Hashanah, the Ten Days of Repentance, etc., the power is given
(sent [shalach]83)
to all of Israel to go to their tents,
to the worldly matters that they engage in during the course of the year,
and to make from them a tent and a Sanctuary for Him, blessed be He,
a dwelling place in the lower realms84.
And this is "he sent the people"
(specifically "the people" [am]),
which is analogous to "in order to85
establish you today as a people for Him" on Rosh Hashanah,
for what is said "as a people for Him"
(specifically)
is because there is no86
king without a people87.
However, on Rosh Hashanah,
the meaning of "people" [am] is
(not from the word "darkness" [omemot]88
but rather on the contrary)
"am" from the word "imo" (with Him)89
(meaning people who are like Him and relate to Him),
and the matter of "he sent the people" of Shemini Atzeret is that they should be in the aspect of "am" from the word "omemot" (darkness/lowliness)90,
and even in this, the aspect of "am" from the word "imo" (with Him)91 will be drawn,
so that through this the power is drawn to "go to their tents,"
to make from their tents, in their simple sense,
the worldly matters,
a tent and a Sanctuary for Him, blessed be He.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The joy and good-heartedness of Shemini Atzeret reveals the innermost love of the heart, and the verse mentions both "Yisrael His people" and "Dovid His servant" to highlight the superiority of the "am" (lowly people) aspect over the "ben" (son) aspect.
section.t: And the verse continues, "joyful and good of heart over all the good that Hashem did for Dovid His servant and for Yisrael His people,"
"joyful and good of heart" is the revelation of the love of the innermost point of the heart
(as explained in the maamar92)
[For after reciting the psalm93
"Of Dovid, Hashem is my light and my salvation" from Rosh Chodesh Elul until Hoshana Rabbah94,
twice each day,
for the point of the psalm is "To You my heart said, 'Seek My face'"95,
one certainly requested that there be a revelation of the innermost point of the heart96,
and on Shemini Atzeret all of Yisrael become joyful and good of heart],
"over all the good that Hashem did for Dovid His servant,"
the aspect of His kingship, blessed be He,
"and for Yisrael His people,"
who engage in the building of the world
(as it is said97
"And all your children [banayich] are students of Hashem," do not read "banayich" (your children) but "bonayich" (your builders)98),
for the building of the world is the aspect of His kingship, blessed be He99.
And it can be said,
that Yisrael is the aspect of a son [ben]
(as is known regarding the matter of Yaakov and Yisrael,
that Yaakov is the aspect of a servant and Yisrael is the aspect of a son100),
and "am" (people) is from the word "omemot" (darkness/lowliness)
(as above),
the aspect of a servant, which is lower than the aspect of a son.
But there is also an advantage in this, that Yisrael are "His people" over that they are "His sons"
(as explained above101).
Therefore it says here "and for Yisrael His people,"
[indicating] both virtues102.
And in the manner explained above regarding the matter of "he sent the people,"
which is the connection of "am" from the word "imo" (with Him)
(people like Him)
with "am" from the word "omemot" (darkness/lowliness).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The second day of Shemini Atzeret (Simchas Torah) hints at the transformation of the profane into the holy, drawing power for the entire year in a manner of peace like in the days of Shlomo, serving as preparation for the ultimate peace of Moshiach.
section.t: And 4)

Based on all the above, we can also explain that which is written in Divrei HaYamim, "And on the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people etc.," which is a hint to the second day of Yom Tov in the diaspora
(as above at the beginning of the maamar of the Tzemach Tzedek),
for the matter of the second day of Yom Tov is103
that even a day which in itself is a weekday,
Yisrael make it into a Yom Tov
(holiness),
and therefore the verse hints at the matter of the second day of Yom Tov specifically on Shemini Atzeret,
and specifically in the matter of "he sent the people" within Shemini Atzeret itself,
for the matter of "he sent the people etc." is
(as explained at length above)
the giving of power from Shemini Atzeret for the entire year to make the worldly matters
(which in themselves are profane)
into a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He.
And it should be added,
that this giving of power drawn on the second day of Yom Tov of Shemini Atzeret
(Simchas Torah)
is more connected to the world than the drawing of the first day of Yom Tov104,
since even before the going to their tents,
on Shemini Atzeret itself,
there already takes place
(on its second day of Yom Tov)
the transformation of the profane into the holy.
And therefore it adds
(in Divrei HaYamim)
"and for Shlomo,"
for the giving of power for the work of refining [birurim] during the entire year, drawn from the second day of Yom Tov of Shemini Atzeret
[on which the matter of transforming the profane into the holy already takes place,
and particularly since on this day we read in the Torah "Bereishis"105
"In the beginning, G-d created the heavens and the earth"]
is in a manner that the refinement of the sparks will be as it was in the days of Shlomo,
about whom it is said106
"Shlomo will be his name, and peace and quiet I will give to Yisrael in his days,"
refinement in a way of peace and tranquility107.
And this is a close preparation for the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu,
who is from the seed of Dovid and Shlomo108,
for then there will be true and complete peace,
in a manner even more elevated than it was in the days of Shlomo,
for the peace that was in the days of Shlomo was that all were nullified due to the revelation of light
(but they were not transformed into holiness),
but in the future it will be the opposite109,
"For then I will turn to the peoples a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Hashem, to serve Him with one accord"110,
with the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu, speedily and truly.
